## What changed vs leg 1

Leg 1 (PR #292) stopped at `revisions`: production mounts
`sig-alert-webhook-token` on `sig-alerts` (env `SIG_ALERT_WEBHOOK_TOKEN`)
while the landed declaration denied `sig-alerts-rt` any secret access — a
production read contradicting a record. This PR amends the declaration to the
least-privilege truth and nothing else: `sig-alert-webhook-token`'s
`consumers` gains `sig-alerts-rt`; `ops/gcp/iam-service-accounts.sh`'s
`bindings`/`rollback` name the derived grant; `ops/gcp/config.sh` + tests +
fixtures updated accordingly (63 focused tests green).

## What ran

`ops/gcp/iam-service-accounts.sh --apply` per step against
`zeta-medley-508121-u7` (ADC present; `SIG_GCP_PROJECT` exported on every
call; no secret value read, printed, logged or persisted):

| step | result |
|---|---|
| `prestate` | AR-2 restore point captured — semantically identical to leg 1's post-rollback state; declared diff = exactly the eight pending mutations, nothing else (`pre/`, sha256 sidecars) |
| `identities` | `sig-api-rt`, `sig-web-rt`, `sig-alerts-rt` created |
| `bindings` | `cloudsql.client`→`sig-api-rt`; `objectViewer`→`sig-web-rt` (web bucket); `secretAccessor`→`sig-api-rt` on `sig-pg-password`; **`secretAccessor`→`sig-alerts-rt` on `sig-alert-webhook-token`** |
| `revisions` | `sig-api`→`sig-api-00011-wic`, `sig-web`→`sig-web-00005-hbr`, `sig-alerts`→`sig-alerts-00007-qcs` — each serving 100 % on its runtime SA at a byte-identical image digest |
| `invoker` | `roles/run.invoker` → the recorded caller SA first, then `allUsers` revoked — `sig-alerts` now IAM-invoked only (anonymous probe: HTTP 403 after ~90 s propagation; `sig-api`/`sig-web` stay public 200 by declaration) |
| `verify` | poststate `post/` — `iam diff --leg services` **clean**, `check-revisions` clean, `route-compare verify` **39/39 byte-identical per service** (117/117) |

Posture: no runtime SA holds a basic role, no `*.delete` on the spine/evidence
stores, no foreign-secret accessor (troubleshooter reads unavailable —
recorded non-fatal; the verdict is the captured-policy analysis, no GRANTED
pair). `live:P34.42a` **satisfied**.
